caseName: Eastern Air Lines, Inc. v. Northeast Airlines, Inc.
caseNameFull: Eastern Air Lines, Inc. v. Northeast Airlines, Inc.
attorneys: John W. Cross, E. Smythe Gambrell and Harold L. Russell for petitioners., Henry E. Foley and Loyd M. Starrett for respondent Northeast Airlines, Inc. Edward J. Hickey, Jr., James L. Highsaw, Jr., and William J. Hickey for International Association of Machinists et al.

opinions.text:
C. A. 1st Cir. Motion of International Association of Machinists et al. to be named parties respondent granted. Motion for leave to supplement the petition granted. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions or the petition.
